canonical_statement: For an integrable real-valued observable on an ergodic probability-preserving measurable endomorphism, the finite-orbit Cesaro averages converge almost everywhere to the integral of the observable.
domain_and_universes: universe u; X : Type u; MeasurableSpace X; mu : Measure X; IsProbabilityMeasure mu; T : X -> X; f : X -> Real; Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: Ergodic T mu (includes measurability and MeasurePreserving T mu mu)
conclusion: For mu-almost every x, Tendsto (fun n => birkhoffAverage Real T f n x) atTop (nhds (integral mu f)).
minimal_import_evidence: Deleting each direct import separately makes Lean reject respectively the Birkhoff average, Ergodic predicate, or Integrable/integral vocabulary. No legacy mean-ergodic module is imported.
alternate_encoding: ExpandedFiniteSumTarget replaces birkhoffAverage by n^{-1} times the Finset.range n orbit sum; the checked iff is definitional simplification and uses no convergence theorem.

killed: weakened Ergodic T mu to MeasurePreserving T mu mu
strengthened almost-everywhere convergence to pointwise-everywhere convergence

degenerate_case_policy: The average is indexed by every Nat and has value zero at n = 0, which does not affect the atTop limit. No nonempty-space or invertibility assumption is added. Null exceptional sets remain permitted. Ergodicity carries measure preservation and measurability, and probability normalization fixes the constant limit as integral mu f rather than a normalized integral expression.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory at the statement gate; the statement and its definitional transport add no local axioms and provide no root proof.
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, pinned Lean 4.29.0 executable, and pinned mathlib revision; pre-existing canonical .lake artifacts reused without mutation.
computation_profile: Prop-only noncomputational target and definitional statement transport.
status_boundary: This freezes and kernel-elaborates only the intake-selected Birkhoff target. It does not locate or credit a pointwise ergodic proof, establish H0 source fidelity, freeze obligations, or claim theorem completion.
